name: Petrochemical Steam Cracking & Olefin Fractionation Package
description: Petrochemical pyrolysis furnace and cryogenic olefin separation train: thermal cracking of hydrocarbon feed at 840°C, multi-stage cracked gas compression, cryogenic chilling train, demethanizer (-100°C), deethanizer, and C2 splitter with unreacted ethane recycle loop.
author: NebuDCS Standard Library
thermodynamic_requirements: Cryogenic Hydrocarbon Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium (Peng-Robinson EOS down to -120°C)
control_strategies: TIC-501 Pyrolysis Furnace Coil Outlet Temperature Control (COT)
PIC-501 Demethanizer Cryogenic Overhead Pressure Control via Chilling Condenser
AIC-501 C2 Splitter Overhead Polymer-Grade Ethylene Purity Control
FIC-501 Unreacted Ethane Recycle Flow Pacing to Furnace
validation_rules: VLD-PET01: Demethanizer overhead requires cryogenic refrigerant utility supply
VLD-PET02: Ethane recycle stream must close the loop back to cracking furnace charge mixer
scientific_references: Chauvel, A. & Lefebvre, G., Petrochemical Processes: Technical and Economic Characteristics, Editions Technip
Zimmermann, H. & Walzl, R., Ethylene in Ullmann's Encyclopedia of Industrial Chemistry, Wiley-VCH
King, C.J., Separation Processes, 2nd Ed., McGraw-Hill
model_classifications: TheoreticalModel (Cryogenic low-temperature cubic EOS phase equilibrium)
IndustryCommonEngineeringModel (Radical cracking conversion and product yields)
